column2: Retain sleep with the fathers, burial beside them in David's city and succession by Joram. The repeated paternal relation is not discarded as redundant.
Retain six brothers and both occurrences of Azarias in the roster, followed by the repeated identification as Jehoshaphat's sons. The duplicate name is not silently emended.
Retain silver, gold, weapons and walled cities as the brothers' gifts, and Joram's kingdom because he was firstborn. Weapons is not replaced with valuables from another textual form.
Retain Joram's rise and strengthening, killing all his brothers by sword and some Israelite rulers. The partitive rulers is distinct from all the brothers.
Retain age thirty-two, establishment over the kingdom and eight years in Jerusalem. The later repeated regnal summary is not used to delete this occurrence.
Retain Israel's royal ways, Ahab's household example, marriage to his daughter and evil before the Lord. The wife is not newly named within this verse.
Retain the Lord's unwillingness to destroy David's house because of His covenant and promised perpetual lamp for David and his sons. The lamp image is not replaced with an explanatory dynasty noun.
Retain Edom's departure from Judah and installation of its own king. The collective singular Edom and subsequent plural they refer to the same people.

Retain rulers and cavalry accompanying Joram, nighttime attack on encircling Edom and the chariot commanders, and the people's flight to tents. Horses/cavalry is not changed to the separate chariot category.
column3: The side to which the chariot commanders and fleeing people belong remains contextually unresolved.

column2: Retain Edom's continuing separation, Lomna's contemporary revolt from his hand and the explanation that he abandoned his fathers' God. Do not assign Edom's revolt itself a different ending date.

Retain high places in Judah's cities, causing Jerusalem's inhabitants to prostitute themselves and leading Judah astray. Cities is not changed to mountains and the strong prostitution language is not softened.

Retain the written message from Elias and divine speech referring to David and Jehoshaphat as fathers, alongside Asa's ways. Do not change the prophet to resolve historical chronology; ordinary your addresses Joram.

Retain Israel's kings, induced prostitution following Ahab's house, and murdered brothers explicitly better than Joram. The moral comparison concerns the brothers, not a claim that their reigns were better.
Retain the Lord striking Joram with a great blow in his people, sons, wives and all belongings. The human addressee's ordinary your remains appropriate inside divine speech.
Retain grievous sickness, belly disease, the belly coming out and day-to-day duration. Do not replace the source's bodily description with a modern diagnosis.
column3: Belly versus bowels and the temporal expression require further lexical and readability review; inherited wording is provisional.

column2: Retain the Lord stirring up foreigners, Arabs and neighbors of Ethiopians. The three coordinated groups are not reduced to an adjective identifying only the Arabs.

Retain invasion, overpowering, removal of household belongings, sons and daughters, and only Ahaziah the youngest son left. Daughters is not changed to wives or Ahaziah to another name to harmonize a parallel.
Retain after all this and the Lord's incurable blow to the belly. No modern medical judgment is added beyond the narrative's no-cure statement.
Retain the difficult time-of-days wording and explicit two days, the bodily outcome, grievous death and absence of the ancestral funeral procession. Do not substitute two years or a cremation rite.
column3: The repeated days expression and bodily wording remain unresolved provisional calques, not accepted literary polish.

column2: Retain the repeated age thirty-two and eight-year reign, departure without praise and burial in David's city outside the royal tombs. Without praise is not expanded into an assertion that nobody mourned.

Retain Jerusalem's residents appointing the younger son, all older ones killed by the raiders, and the Arabs and Alimazonians. Do not identify Alimazonians with a modern people or erase its difference from 14:14.
Retain accession at twenty and a one-year reign, with Athaliah daughter of Omri. Do not substitute twenty-two or forty-two, or alter daughter to granddaughter to reconcile genealogies.
column3: Age and kinship remain selected-reading questions; the English names follow the inherited provisional name policy.

column2: Retain his mother's counsel in sinning as the explanation for walking in Ahab's house's way. The agency is hers and the walk his.

Retain evil before the Lord, Ahab's household as counselors after his father's death and their destructive effect. To destroy him retains the purpose/result ambiguity rather than alleging a separately narrated conspiracy.

Retain following their counsels, the joint campaign with Joram son of Ahab against Hazael at Rama-galaad, and archers striking Joram. Archers is not replaced with Syrians merely because the next verse names them.
Retain the two Joram patronymics, healing at Jezrael, wounds from Syrians at Rama and Ahaziah's visit because Joram was ill. The explicit patronymics prevent conflating the two royal families.

Retain Ahaziah's downfall from God, Joram going out with him, Jehu son of Namessi, the Lord's anointed and the dangling Ahab's house. No absent destroy verb is imported to repair the selected fragment.
column3: The final accusative Ahab's house has no expressed governing verb here. The dash exposes unresolved syntax and is not an accepted finished literary solution.

column2: Retain Jehu's vengeance on Ahab's house, Judah's rulers and Ahaziah's brothers ministering to him, followed by their killing. Brothers is not changed to nephews to resolve the earlier slaughter notice.

Retain search, treatment in Samaria, capture, delivery to Jehu, killing and burial because of descent from Jehoshaphat. Treatment is not changed to hiding; son remains unexpanded despite the genealogical distance.
column3: The final power-over-the-kingdom construction remains a provisional English resolution of the compressed Greek.

column2: Retain Athaliah's recognition of her son's death and destruction of all royal offspring in Judah's house. The following rescue qualifies the narrative without requiring deletion of all here.

Retain Joash's theft from the dying royal sons, his nurse, chamber of beds, Jehoshabeath's full family and marital identification and repeated hiding. The final named Athaliah supplies the inferred subject of did not kill, not a gender marked by the Greek verb.
column3: Chamber of beds and the final unexpressed subject remain provisional contextual renderings.

column2: Retain concealment with her in God's house for six years and Athaliah ruling the land. The six years refer to hiding, not a newly calculated total reign beyond this clause.
